summary.text: Richard Raymond is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 42 who took office on January 24, 2001 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Richard Raymond received both his J.D. and B.A. from the University of Texas at Austin.
He works as a businessman and a consultant.
Raymond's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Ways & Means and State Affairs.
He chaired the Defense & Veterans' Affairs Committee in 2021-2022 and the Human Services Committee in the 2011-2017 sessions.
He sponsored the Texas Open Beaches Amendment, which voters approved in November 2009.
